_help: §EO.1 (5 Oct, Mike by voice). The head under every tribe's hood; the shared cloaked rig is unchanged. Homes are Claude's first guess from each animal's real range; the designer owns them.

tiger.home: tropical and temperate forest of Asia, taiga edge

pig.home: temperate and tropical forest (the wild boar)

peoples._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.1 wiring (6 Oct): which animal each people's folk are, a first guess from heads.*.home (the designer owns it). Seventeen peoples, eleven real animals: some share. The dragon is no people's: it is the rare tribe (rare.dragon). A people not listed keeps the empty hood.

rare._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.1 wiring: the dragon tribe ("rare, hidden"). chance_per_camp: the share of the world's people's camps whose folk are dragons instead of their people's animal, rolled from the camp's seed (the opening camp never).

look._help: Added by Claude Code with the §EO.1 wiring. The face is drawn only up close: within near_m (metres from the eye) fully, fading into the hood's flat dark hollow by gone_m, so from further off the figure reads as a person (an empty hood). hood_shade: how much light reaches into the hood (1 = all of it), so a face shows best by firelight. Folk kinds that keep the empty hood: no_head_kinds (the small folk with their lanterns, §BO; not retired). Colours (sRGB) per animal: fur, the muzzle or face, the accent (nose, beak, comb, horn); the shapes are in scripts/creatures/beast_heads.gd.
